description.zh: 给定问题中已成立的机制、非平凡桥接、条件边界与统一结构；28家族按题面结构机会加权，不再混入开放手稿或独立研究能力分。
description.en: Established mechanisms, nontrivial bridges, conditions and unifying structure in prescribed problems; 28 task-weighted families, separate from open manuscripts and independent research.

description.zh: 明确开放请求中的目标组织、实质机制、自然范围与可用成果；五道手稿和一次独立研究分别重评，六机会固定加权，不由旧能力分换算。
description.en: Formulation, substantive mechanisms, justified scope and usable outcomes under explicit open requests; five manuscripts and one independent study, freshly assessed with fixed opportunity weights.

depth.2: A substantive key mechanism is proved in a frozen task opportunity.
depth.3: Mechanism, nontrivial bridge and justified conditions form an independent important structural result in a stated scope.
depth.4: The main structural core is established and unified over the original problem family; a complete short single-mechanism proof can suffice.

open_research.2: Useful substantive work exists but an essential goal, mechanism, branch, dependency, scope or return bridge remains unestablished.
open_research.3: All essential core mechanisms, branches and scope are established; only an explicit local gap requiring no new mechanism, assumption or scope change remains.
open_research.4: The actual open request is answered by a rigorous, faithful, substantive, self-contained and usable research core.

unknown_rule: Fixed denominators; unknown grade retains [0,4]; exact null when unresolved; settled blank with no admissible work is zero.
depth_core_rule: A failed unifying core cannot earn4; an independently established important local structure may earn3 with explicit dependency separation.
open_core_rule: Any essential missing/refuted core or unbridged scope caps2; grade3 needs a concrete local-gap witness; grade4 needs a complete closure chain.
independent_research_rule: One opportunity, selected last prescribed artifact; earlier rounds only context, never a union, best-of or three independent samples.
scope: Current1.3 two profile axes only; historical1.0–1.2, original reviews, main scores and all other axes unchanged.
